description: This file defines ORM classes and functions for interacting with the JWQL PostgreSQL database, including connection setup, table definitions, and factory functions for anomalies and monitor tables.

classes.name: FilesystemGeneral
classes.description: ORM class for the general filesystem monitor table

classes.name: FilesystemInstrument
classes.description: ORM class for instrument-specific filesystem monitor table

classes.name: CentralStore
classes.description: ORM class for central storage filesystem monitor table

classes.name: Monitor
classes.description: ORM class for the monitor status table

methods.name: load_connection
methods.description: Establishes database connection, returning session, base, engine, and metadata objects.

methods.name: anomaly_orm_factory
methods.description: Creates ORM classes for anomaly tables based on class name.

methods.name: get_monitor_columns
methods.description: Reads table definition files to generate monitor table columns.

methods.name: get_monitor_table_constraints
methods.description: Adds constraints to monitor table definitions.

methods.name: monitor_orm_factory
methods.description: Creates ORM classes for monitor tables based on class name.

methods.name: set_read_permissions
methods.description: Sets database read permissions for user accounts.
